definition: Fleeting means lasting only an instant and gone before you can hold it — over almost as soon as it is noticed.
task: Write one sentence of your own using the word fleeting. Make the sentence show what the word means -- a reader who did not know fleeting should be able to work it out from your sentence.

Evanescent is stronger than fleeting — a fleeting moment at least arrives whole before it goes, while an evanescent one is already dissolving as it appears, like breath on cold glass.
